body.lit: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may place up to 3 Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.

label.lit: Save up to 3 Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait.

body.lit: [On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait from under your Tamers without paying the cost.

label.lit: Play 1 play cost 4 or lower [Xros Heart] Digimon
